I sent Pree the Marrow Fieldworks ticket list in your DM. I found three confirmed tickets and one possible match.

**Confirmed:**
- **#4409:** from Moss's "Central handoffs next week" digest (2 Jan 2026). A report on the Salina North yard check-in keeps timing out.
- **#4412:** from the same digest. A glitch in the text messages sent to drivers when staging combine trailers.
- **PD-5302:** from #central-random. Hollis posted it on 14 Oct as a follow-up from this week. It's the only Marrow Fieldworks ticket in this week's chat.

**Possible:**
- **#8841:** from #central-random, posted by Tobias on 13 Oct, about a door being double-booked on "Tobias's dealer account." The thread never names the account, so I said I couldn't confirm it's Marrow Fieldworks.

**Left out:**
- FR-882 and PD-4821 are both for Marrow Agrisupply, a different account.
- Moss's Central cheat sheet has no ticket numbers.
- #central-team has nothing from this week, and the DM had nothing else.

I only checked places Pree can see: #central-random, #central-team, the DM and Moss's shared digests. Moss has no personal notes folder I could open, and no account ticket files were available to check against.
